She has a fair complexion and is wearing a white ribbed shirt. The background is a brightly lit indoor room with a shelf visible behind her. (2) A close-up shot features a hand holding a square-shaped glass bottle of foundation with a black cap. The label reads 'shu uemura unlimited'. (3) The foundation is dispensed onto the back of a hand, showing a creamy, light-beige liquid texture. (4) The woman applies the foundation to her face using her fingertips and then blends it out with a white triangular makeup sponge. Large variety text overlays appear on the screen during this process. (5) A split-screen shot compares the left side of her face (before) with the right side (after), showing a more even skin tone and covered imperfections. (6) A transition graphic with a light purple background and a stylized cat face appears with text indicating a time jump. (7) The woman returns to the frame, touching her cheek with her fingers to show the makeup's durability after a long period. She smiles and gives a thumbs up.
